name: Mahlon
title: Ruth's first husband
summary: Mahlon was the son of Elimelech and Naomi from Bethlehem. He moved with his family to Moab during a famine, where he married the Moabite Ruth. He died childless in Moab after about ten years of marriage.

keyEvents.title: Flight to Moab
keyEvents.description: Due to a famine in Judah, Mahlon moved with his family from Bethlehem to the land of Moab.

keyEvents.title: Marriage to Ruth
keyEvents.description: Mahlon and his brother Chilion married Moabite women. Mahlon took Ruth as his wife.

keyEvents.title: Death in Moab
keyEvents.description: After about ten years in Moab, both Mahlon and his brother Chilion died, leaving their wives as widows without children.

keyEvents.title: Boaz Redeems Mahlon's Inheritance
keyEvents.description: Boaz took on the role of kinsman-redeemer for Mahlon's property and married Ruth to carry on Mahlon's name.
